note: The subject is #325: a downstream consumer resolving providers fresh in CI met Scaleway 2.81.0 the morning after it shipped, and nothing this project published would have let them pin deliberately. Every mutation here turns the page back into the thing it replaces — a table that reads as a measurement and is not one. The first two are the ones that matter most, because they fail in the direction a reader cannot detect: a constraint printed as an exact version, and a missing constraint filled in from the row above. `~> 1.7` is resolved by `terraform init -upgrade` on the runner, and two required_providers blocks in this repository carry no version at all.
